value.rules_markdown:
- Use `src/` as single crate: one responsibility per module, core types in module-local `types.rs`, every port in `src/ports/` one trait one file.
- Declare every CLI subcommand in `src/bin/tinysweeper.rs` even if not yet implemented, for stable script/runbook surface.
- Keep `src/server/` as only production surface; do not distribute/run as GitHub Action; credential-holding code belongs in src/server, not workflows.
- Treat `presets/` review policy as data: each preset is a folder with `preset.toml`+`README.md`; adding preset means new folder, never new module.
- Never edit `vendor/tinyagents` here; change it upstream in its own repo and bump the git submodule pin.
- Provide `docs/modules/<module>/README.md` for every `src/` module.
- Declare examples in `Cargo.toml` with `required-features` so credential-needing smoke tests never build in CI.
- Default build must be offline: no HTTP client, tests no network; network goes behind feature flags (`harness`, `github`, `serve`).
- Use rustfmt and Rust 2024 idioms; `snake_case` modules/files, `PascalCase` types.
- Return `Result<T>` using the crate error type from `src/error.rs`.
- Every file starts with a `//!` module doc describing role and feature gating.
- Comments explain decisions, not code; say when a flag/ordering is load-bearing and why.
- Public items carry doc comments; Clap fields use `///` to become help text.
- Tests live in-crate as `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` at bottom, moving to sibling test file when large; no `tests/` directory.
- Every port has an always-compiled offline mock; `MockForge` records intended writes for assertions.
- Cover lane behaviour with golden tests: fixture diff + canned model response, assert findings after filtering/dedupe/capping.
- Maintain at least 80% test coverage for meaningful library behaviour.
- Keep every Markdown file at 500 lines or fewer; split and link when exceeded.
- Treat security invariants as non-negotiable; changing any requires explicit discussion in the pull request.
- Model never holds write token; lanes run read-only checkout; write credentials minted only in `src/apply/` after all model calls return.
- Never execute contributor code; read diff/tree only; do not build, install dependencies, or run target repo scripts.
- Treat PR bodies/comments/diffs as untrusted input; fence/label as data; model verdict advisory; only deterministic policy in `src/apply/` and `src/automerge/` mutates GitHub.
- Report secrets by type and location only; never include secret value in comments, check-run summaries, or logs.
- Use concise imperative commit subjects; keep commits small; commit each coherent validated slice separately.
- Pull requests state what changed, any behaviour change, and how it was verified.
